rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (22 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gloria_(Sam_Smith_album), https://www.hoopladigital.com/music/gloria-[special-edition]-sam-smith/15896910. Special Edition, 22 tracks across 2 discs. Disc 1: 13 standard tracks. Disc 2: 2 studio bonus tracks (Kissing You, Heavenly Sent) + 7 live tracks from Royal Albert Hall. Verified against Wikipedia, hoopla, Deezer, and jazz-jazz.com. Note: The 7 live tracks are also released as the standalone 'Live from the Royal Albert Hall' EP.
